description: This file contains Go source code implementing functions to locate, ensure, and manage the runtime of a 'pi' executable, including environment configuration, path resolution, and installation procedures.

methods.name: resolveDocsPiCommand
methods.description: Resolves the 'pi' command to use, either from environment, system PATH, or by ensuring the runtime is materialized.

methods.name: shouldMaterializePiRuntime
methods.description: Decides whether to materialize a 'pi' runtime based on its path, by checking for a specific directory pattern.

methods.name: ensureMaterializedPiRuntime
methods.description: Ensures the 'pi' runtime is installed and ready, installing it via npm if necessary, and caches the result.

methods.name: getMaterializedPiRuntimeDir
methods.description: Returns the directory path where the materialized 'pi' runtime is stored, based on user cache or temp directory.

methods.name: getMaterializedPiPackageVersion
methods.description: Gets the version of the 'pi' package to use, either from environment variable or default.
